entities.name: Janez Lenarčič
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Janez Lenarčič is a Slovenian diplomat who served as European Commissioner for Crisis Management in the first Von der Leyen Commission from 2019 to 2024. He is a former director of the Office for Democratic Institutions and Human Rights within the Organization for Security and Co-operation in Europe.

entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Janez Lenarčič is a Slovenian diplomat who served as European Commissioner for Crisis Management in the first Von der Leyen Commission from 2019 to 2024. He is a former director of the Office for Democratic Institutions and Human Rights within the Organization for Security and Co-operation in Europe.
